educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Understand the abstract of machine learning and acquire how to implement it on a computer.
(2) Acquire how to conduct scientific computing.
(3) Acquire how to visualize data.
advice: This course provides instruction on utilizing a computer to handle data. This course covers various topics, including handling outliers, missing data values, representative parameters, and typical machine learning methods based on linear algebra and statistics. Students will learn about supervised and unsupervised learning, both part of machine learning, through practical analysis using Python libraries. Students will also learn how to visualize analysis results effectively. It is recommended that before taking this course, one should have a foundational understanding of Linear Algebra and Statistics. Depending on the progress of the lecture, other content may be added, and the timing of quizzes and achievement assessment tests may change. Please follow the specific instructions of the instructor.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course provides instruction on utilizing a computer to handle data. This course covers various topics, including handling outliers, missing data values, representative parameters, and typical machine learning methods based on linear algebra and statistics. Students will learn about supervised and unsupervised learning, both part of machine learning, through practical analysis using Python libraries. Students will also learn how to visualize analysis results effectively. It is recommended that before taking this course, one should have a foundational understanding of Linear Algebra and Statistics. Depending on the progress of the lecture, other content may be added, and the timing of quizzes and achievement assessment tests may change. Please follow the specific instructions of the instructor.
